text:
natalie: Heads up  working on the SOC2 doc section called 'Retention exceptions & legal hold'. Need a plain-language blurb and a tiny example about TTL override. @omar can you confirm the process?

omar: Process is Support creates a legal-hold ticket -> infra sets retention flag 'legal_hold:true' on records -> retention enforcement skips those records. Default legal hold window is 365 days unless extended.

natalie: draft sentence: 'Records subject to an approved legal hold are retained for the hold duration; platform retention enforcement will not delete those records.'

qa-bot: Note: verify the 'legal_hold' flag key with infra. Link: internal/infra/retention-flags -> 404

omar: Key is correct but name of flag is 'legal_hold_active', not 'legal_hold'. Also mention that legal holds are scoped to tenant and case id.

natalie: updated wording: 'Records subject to an approved legal hold (flag: legal_hold_active) are retained for the hold duration; platform retention enforcement will not delete those records. Legal holds are tenant-scoped and linked to an internal case id.'

omar: LGTM. Add one-line about audit trail: we log changes to legal_hold_active including who requested and timestamp.

natalie: ok will add: 'Changes to legal hold state are recorded in the audit trail (who, when, case id).'

qa-bot: link check: https://redwood.internal/infra/retention-flags -> 200 OK

natalie: great. I'll drop this into the retention exceptions page and open PR. Tagging @omar for review.

omar: thanks. :thumbsup:
